description: List where Agentcard shops. With no arguments: the merchants that use an account (DoorDash, flights, the retail stores) and whether this user has linked each, plus how many online stores Agentcard buys from with no account. To check one store, pass `query` with its name or domain (Nike, nordstrom.com): the search covers both kinds. An online store needs no link: ask buy for the product and name the store.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` an earlier call returned. Pass the same `query` and `kind` with it.

kind.description: Which merchants to list: `direct` (merchants that use an account), `catalog` (online stores with no account) or `all`. Without it, `direct`, or `all` with a `query`.

query.description: A store's name or domain, e.g. 'Nike' or 'nordstrom.com'.

name: buy_list_merchants

count.description: Number of merchants returned on this page.

counts.description: How many merchants of each kind match the query, across every page.

merchants.description: The merchants on this page: `direct` ones with this user's link status, then `catalog` online stores.

domain.description: Catalog stores only: the store's website, e.g. nike.com.

kind.description: `direct`: a merchant that uses an account. `catalog`: an online store Agentcard buys from with no account.

link_status.description: Direct merchants only. 'ready' (no account needed) or 'linked' (account linked): shop now. 'unlinked': no account linked yet. 'pending': a link was started and not finished. 'error': the last link attempt failed.

slug.description: Merchant id. A catalog store has no account to link, so buy_connect refuses it.

message.description: Human-readable merchant list (or an error / empty note).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor`, with the same `query` and `kind`, for the next page; `null` on the last page.
